Evette Finikin placed 5th with 13.03, first British girl behind two Hungarians and two Italians in a close competition won in 13.49. Sue Drummie set an inaugural Club best being the first Belgrave woman on record to compete in the pole vault.
Sue Drummie was 8th with 2.50, Julia Cockram 9th with 2.30 and Jacqui Smiter was unable to clear her opening height - just the sort of problem Mike Edwards sometimes has!
